basic_info.description: This eclectic Mid-Century Modern three-bedroom home in San Francisco's desirable Portola District showcases delightful design and period details. The inviting south-facing facade leads to a formal living room featuring a wood-burning fireplace and stunning hardwood floors, all bathed in natural light from a wall of windows that offers dramatic views. At the heart of the home, the charming kitchen includes a skylight and a spacious eat-in dining area. Three generous bedrooms and a full bathroom complete this level, including a beautiful walk-out deck from the primary bedroom with views of downtown and the water.  The updated lower level features a convenient laundry area, a stylishly remodeled full bathroom, and a large flex space with polished concrete floors, perfect for a fourth bedroom or family room. Direct access to a serene, low-maintenance garden allows for creative gardening opportunities. The spacious garage accommodates two cars in tandem and offers ample storage with built-in shelving for projects.  Lovingly maintained by just two owners since 1950, this home reflects careful attention to detail. With a prime location near freeway access, schools, and shops on San Bruno Avenue, it perfectly blends charm, style, and convenience.
